en: The Triplet on the Visible and the Dyad on the Impinging.
Dependent on a non-manifesting, impinging phenomenon that is impinging, there arises a phenomenon that is neither manifesting nor impinging, by way of root condition.

Dependent on a non-manifesting, impinging phenomenon that is impinging, there arises a phenomenon that is neither non-manifesting-and-impinging nor impinging, by way of root condition. Dependent on a non-manifesting, impinging phenomenon...

Dependent on phenomena that are non-demonstrable and impinging (*na-anidassana-sappaṭigha*) and non-impinging (*na-appaṭigha*), there arise phenomena that are non-demonstrable and impinging (*na-anidassana-sappaṭigha*) and non-impinging (*na-appaṭigha*) by way of root-condition (*hetu-paccaya*).
(Abbreviated. Under root-condition there are three; ... pe ... under non-disappearance-condition (*avigata*) there are three.

Dependent on a phenomenon that is non-demonstrable, non-impinging, and non-impinging (*anidassana-appaṭigha* and *appaṭigha*), [there arises] a phenomenon that is non-demonstrable, non-impinging, and non-impinging...
A phenomenon arises by way of root condition (*hetu-paccaya*). Dependent on a non-manifesting, non-reactive, and non-obstructive phenomenon,
there arises a phenomenon that is neither manifesting-nor-reactive-nor-non-obstructive by way of root condition …pe… dependent on a non-manifesting, non-reactive, and non-obstructive phenomenon,
there arise [phenomena] that are neither non-manifesting-nor-reactive-nor-non-obstructive and neither non-manifesting-nor-non-reactive-nor-non-obstructive by way of root condition.
States arise with the root condition. (Abbreviated. Five in the case of the root; five in the case of the predominance [condition] ...
pe ... three in the case of mutuality ... pe ... five in the case of non-disappearance.
